name: duru-korean
description: Static site for durukorean.com. Node is used only for the serverless functions under api/ and the scripts under scripts/; the pages themselves are plain HTML, CSS and browser JavaScript and need no build step. The runtime dependency is the Anthropic SDK, used by the default translation provider; the OpenAI, Google and DeepL providers speak plain HTTP and need nothing. Playwright is a build-time dependency only — it renders the downloads to PDF in the daily run and drives the browser tests. Nothing in devDependencies is served to a visitor.
